objective: Make an unavailable evidence timeline a visible partial failure, distinct from a timeline that has not been requested and from a run with no events.
decision_supported: Should a failed timeline read look like an empty one? No: an operator reading a partial evidence view has to be able to tell a missing phase-checked projection from an absent one.
acceptance: A non-2xx timeline response is rendered as a named failure, not as not-loaded.
A timeline belonging to another run still reads as not-loaded.
A timeline loaded for the current run still renders its items.
stop_conditions: The fix would need a backend response shape change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Treating every non-ok as a failure could hide a 204 no-content; the API returns 200 with an empty list instead.
